places.quote: we must really go to Thavies Inn at once if we were to go at all that day
places.note: Jellyby family house; the narrator and Caddy travel there and the scene is set there.

places.quote: either gone or going to the left bank of the Niger.
places.note: Mrs. Jellyby's emigration destination, referred to by her; the Niger is real but the settlement is not.

places.quote: in connexion with Borrioboola-Gha and it is so necessary
places.note: Fictional African settlement in Mrs. Jellyby's scheme.

places.quote: Not if it's Africa, Ma, I have not.
places.note: Continent; Caddy's and Mrs. Jellyby's reference.
